meta.name: B - lower vault seed minimum to 90 USDG
meta.description: setParams on VaultLauncher. Only minSeedEscrow changes (1,000 -> 90 USDG). The other four are passed at their current on-chain values so they are not reset. RUN A SECOND TIME, 7 September 2026. This batch executed once and was then undone. A stale proposal sitting in the Safe queue, carrying the launcher's original constructor values, executed at nonce 16 in block 56,853,183 (tx 0x8c92a62ecb2222acf3867c242b9acd5de37806daabc8cd388d43df58b433fd0a) and put minSeedEscrow back to 1,000 USDG. It was found while checking why batch L had not landed: batch L could not execute until that older nonce cleared, and clearing it reverted this. Nothing else moved, because the stale proposal's other four arguments happen to equal the current values. RE-VERIFIED IMMEDIATELY BEFORE RE-PROPOSING, against chain: bondAmount 10000e18, minCoverageBps 500, leaderFeeShareBps 8000, performanceFeeBps 1000 all match this calldata exactly, so running it still changes minSeedEscrow and nothing else. GOVERNANCE_ROLE is still held by this Safe, so it does not need to go through the Timelock. Simulated from the Safe: succeeds. Replayed as the Safe in test/fork/SeedMinimumBatch.t.sol. The live zsUSDG vault is unaffected either way: minSeedEscrow is only read inside the launch path, so it gates new launches and never touches an existing vault's escrow. UNDONE A SECOND TIME, AND THE QUEUE IS THE PROBLEM. This batch executed at block 56,896,762 (tx 0x2f871e61adfc8fa02c2d1bb6a60fd43c2651b7910fbd772f6422a17edac3d518) and sixteen minutes later a second queued proposal, identical to the first and again carrying the launcher's constructor defaults, executed at block 56,906,350 (tx 0x9f1c0c53505d511ee24bc2e2c249927566af03dba5686c96bfdf3a75ffaa8839) and set minSeedEscrow back to 1,000 USDG. So there is more than one of them. DO NOT RE-RUN THIS UNTIL THE QUEUE IS CLEAR. Running it a third time against a queue that still holds one of those entries just repeats the cycle: the entry becomes executable as soon as the nonce reaches it and reverts this again, with no failed transaction anywhere to notice. Delete every unwanted proposal in the Safe first, confirm the queue is empty, then run this and re-check minSeedEscrow afterwards rather than assuming it held.
